diagnosis.reasoning: Prompt token rate is essentially flat (-6%) and request rate actually fell, so this is not a capacity/load event; yet the prefix cache hit rate and cached-token ratio collapsed by ~92%, forcing nearly every prompt token to be recomputed (prefill_kv_computed_p99 ~4400, prefill_time_p99 4.3s). That cache collapse explains the downstream chain: inflated prefill cost, KV usage jumping to 0.79, queue backlog of ~116 waiting requests with 65s queue time, and hence the TTFT blowup. Preemption stayed at zero, so kv_cache_pressure, prefill_cost and queueing are effects rather than the origin.
